bibl.title: Aurelios Ammon from Panopolis: On Hellenistic Literary Roles and Egyptian Priestly Cloth.
bibl.seg: Benjamin Sippel, Aurelios Ammon from Panopolis: On Hellenistic Literary Roles and Egyptian Priestly Cloth.
Mattias Brand & Eline Scheerlinck (edd.), Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri: 3rd-12th Century Egypt (London - New York, 2023) pp. 193-212, figg.
bibl.note: The man playing roles on stage: Ammon's archive and his priestly office. Role 1: the well-educated son writes a letter to mom back home. - Role 2: the middle-aged scholastikos drafts a petition. - Role 3: a proper dress code for complaining. - Conclusion: revisiting Ammon's set of roles.
